topics.title: Why Did I Slice That?
topics.subtitle: Diagnosing the slice — face, path, or both
topics.defaultPrompt: Help me diagnose my slice. Walk me through the most common causes — open face at impact, out-to-in path, weak grip — and how to figure out which is mine.
topics.promptTemplate: Help me diagnose a slice — the most common causes (open face, out-to-in path, weak grip, early extension) and how to identify which one is mine. {{skill_level_context}} {{shot_pattern_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: Use simple language — I'm new to swing diagnosis.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I understand path and face concepts — help me diagnose more precisely.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include path-vs-face ratios, dynamic loft effects, and how to use launch monitor numbers to pinpoint the cause.

options.label: All Slices
options.promptFragment: Cover the most common slice patterns and how to tell them apart.

options.label: Starts Left, Slices Right
options.promptFragment: My ball starts left of target then slices back right — focus on this pattern.

options.label: Starts Straight, Curves Right
options.promptFragment: My ball starts on line then peels right — focus on this pattern.

options.label: Starts Right, Curves More Right
options.promptFragment: My ball starts right of target and curves further right — focus on this pattern.

options.label: Driver Only
options.promptFragment: I only slice the driver — focus on driver-specific slice causes.

options.label: Quick Diagnosis
options.promptFragment: Give me the most likely cause and the highest-leverage fix.

options.label: Detailed Diagnosis
options.promptFragment: Walk me through diagnosis with self-tests for each potential cause.

options.label: Drills to Fix
options.promptFragment: Give me drills that target each potential cause.

topics.promptTemplate: Help me diagnose a hook — common causes (closed face, in-to-out path, strong grip, flipping) and how to identify which is mine. {{skill_level_context}} {{shot_pattern_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

topics.title: Topping the Ball
topics.subtitle: Why you're hitting it thin or skulling it
topics.defaultPrompt: I keep topping the ball or hitting thin shots that skull along the ground. Help me diagnose what's causing it and how to fix it.
topics.promptTemplate: Help me diagnose topped and thin shots — the most common causes (early extension, lifting, wrong ball position, over-swinging) and how to fix them. {{skill_level_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: I'm a newer golfer — keep the language simple and focus on the fix.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I top occasionally — help me identify which fault is mine.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include low-point control, attack angle, and how spine angle changes through the swing produce thins.

options.label: Quick Fix
options.promptFragment: Give me one or two highest-leverage fixes.

options.label: Full Diagnosis
options.promptFragment: Walk me through every common cause and how to identify which is mine.

options.label: Drills
options.promptFragment: Give me drills to fix topping and ground contact.

topics.title: Fat Shots
topics.subtitle: Hitting it heavy — diagnosis and fix
topics.defaultPrompt: I keep hitting it fat — chunking the ball with the club catching the ground first. What causes this and how do I fix it?
topics.promptTemplate: Help me diagnose fat shots — common causes (low point too far behind ball, weight stuck on trail side, casting, over-the-top with steep entry) and how to fix them. {{skill_level_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: Keep the language simple — I just want to know why and how to stop.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I understand low-point concepts — help me identify my specific cause.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include low-point control mechanics, pressure shift patterns, and how attack angle interacts with steepness.

options.label: Quick Fix
options.promptFragment: Give me one or two fixes to try right now.

options.label: Full Diagnosis
options.promptFragment: Walk me through every cause and how to identify mine.

options.label: Drills
options.promptFragment: Give me ground-contact and low-point control drills.

topics.title: Inconsistent Contact
topics.subtitle: When some shots are pure and some are awful
topics.defaultPrompt: My contact is wildly inconsistent — pure one swing, fat or thin or off the toe the next. What causes this kind of inconsistency and how do I tighten it up?
topics.promptTemplate: Help me diagnose inconsistent contact — when shots vary widely in quality. Common causes are unstable low point, wandering ball position, sequence breakdown, and grip pressure variation. {{skill_level_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: Keep it simple — I want practical things I can check.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I have some consistency but want a system for diagnosing the bad swings.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include dispersion analysis, low-point variability, and which mechanical inconsistencies have the highest variance impact.

options.label: Quick Answer
options.promptFragment: Give me the highest-leverage stability check I can run.

options.label: Full Diagnostic
options.promptFragment: Walk through a complete diagnostic process.

options.label: Practice Approach
options.promptFragment: Give me a practice approach that builds consistent contact over time.

topics.title: Sudden Distance Loss
topics.subtitle: When yardages drop and you don't know why
topics.defaultPrompt: My distances have suddenly dropped — every iron is a club shorter than it was. What's the most likely cause and how do I get it back?
topics.promptTemplate: Help me diagnose sudden distance loss — common causes (over-the-top with high spin, decel, weak release, lost lag, mobility/strength changes, equipment wear). {{skill_level_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: Keep the diagnosis practical and focused on what I can check or feel.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I want to systematically rule out causes.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include spin loft, dynamic loft, smash factor, and angle of attack as diagnostic levers.

options.label: Quick Diagnosis
options.promptFragment: Give me the 3 most common causes and what to check first.

options.label: Full Diagnostic
options.promptFragment: Walk through a thorough diagnostic process.

options.label: Drills to Recover
options.promptFragment: Give me drills to recover lost distance once I've identified the cause.

topics.title: Pulls and Pushes
topics.subtitle: Straight shots that miss the target
topics.defaultPrompt: I'm hitting straight shots but they miss left or right of the target — pulls and pushes, not curves. What does this tell me about my swing path and clubface?
topics.promptTemplate: Help me understand pulls and pushes — straight shots that miss the target left or right. What do these patterns tell me about clubface and path? {{skill_level_context}} {{miss_direction_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: Keep it simple — I want to know why straight shots miss.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I understand basic ball flight — help me decode pull/push patterns.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include face-path matching, why straight pulls require matched in-to-out face and path, and how alignment errors masquerade as pulls or pushes.

options.label: Both
options.promptFragment: Cover both pulls and pushes.

options.label: Pull Only (Left)
options.promptFragment: Focus on pulls — straight shots that miss left.

options.label: Push Only (Right)
options.promptFragment: Focus on pushes — straight shots that miss right.

options.label: Quick Diagnosis
options.promptFragment: Give me the bottom line on what these misses mean.

options.label: Full Diagnosis
options.promptFragment: Walk through what causes pulls and pushes and how to fix them.

options.label: Drills
options.promptFragment: Give me drills to fix pulls and pushes.
